latest_release.name: v2.3.1
latest_release.body:
## Known issues

- **Mac users on 2.3.0 or earlier:** Your current version can't install this update. Download 2.3.1 from the [downloads page](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads) and install it. Your data stays as it is. After that, updates install in the app as usual.
- **Windows and Linux** update in the app as before.

## What's Changed
* fix(www): load the homepage without a white band or a heavy footer by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2384
* docs(www): write the SurfSense 2.0 user docs on Fumadocs' Spacious layout by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2383
* docs(www): ship the 2.0 user docs and the homepage loading fixes by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2385
* fix(desktop): install Mac updates over 1 GiB with Electron 44.10.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2387
* docs(changelog): v2.3.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2388
* chore(local): release 2.3.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2389
* [Local|Release] Release desktop 2.3.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2390


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1

detail.readme:
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/MODSetter/SurfSense?style=social)](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/stargazers) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/MODSetter/SurfSense?sort=semver)](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1359368468260192417?label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9)

SurfSense

The air-gapped, open-source NotebookLM alternative.
The AI agent that researches, transforms and edits your documents, on your machine.

Download · Formats · Quick start · Compare · Plugins · Pricing · Discord

English | العربية | Deutsch | Español | Français | हिन्दी | 日本語 | 한국어 | Português | Русский | 简体中文

**Redline a contract with tracked changes and comments** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88326b9d-e763-46db-9635-75f9df9e8682 **Add sources from the web, then turn them into a web page** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/073577b7-f055-4f59-8540-330bd764aeb0 SurfSense is a free, open-source desktop app for documents you can't upload. A privacy-focused, NotebookLM-style AI agent that researches, transforms and edits your documents, on your machine. The index stays on your disk, you pick the model, local or remote, and there is no account. | Platform | Download | |---|---| | **Windows** x64 | [SurfSense-Setup.exe](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/windows?src=readme) | | **macOS** Apple Silicon | [SurfSense-arm64.dmg](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/mac?src=readme) | | **Linux** x64 | [AppImage](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-appimage?src=readme) · [deb](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-deb?src=readme) | | **Docker** Linux, macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.sh \| bash` | | **Docker** Windows (Docker Desktop) | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.ps1 \| iex` | > [!NOTE] > Docker self-hosts it on a server you open from any device on your network. Run the same command again to update. ## Quick start 1. Install SurfSense and do the initial onboarding setup. 2. Drop your files or folders in your sources. 3. Ask the agent to search or extract or edit your files. ## What it does with each format | Format | Research (cited answers) | Create | Edit (as a copy) | Transform | |---|---|---|---|---| | **PDF** | ✓ scanned pages too³ | ✓ | Fill and flatten forms; stamp watermarks, page numbers, headers, footers | Merge, split, extract, rotate, reorder pages | | **Word** `.docx` | ✓ | ✓ or from your own `.docx` as a template | ✓ body text, as tracked changes and comments | To PDF¹ | | **Excel** `.xlsx` | ✓ the agent also reads formulas | ✓ with formulas and native charts | ✓ cell values and formulas | Analyse with pandas, chart the results | | **PowerPoint** `.pptx` | ✓ | ✓ or from your own `.pptx` as a template | Replace text on slides and notes; delete or duplicate slides | To PDF¹ | | **CSV** | ✓ | — | — | Analyse with pandas, chart the results | | **Images** PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, WebP | ✓ text read by OCR³ | Images and infographics, edited by instruction² | — | Place in new documents | | **Markdown**, plain text | ✓ | ✓ Markdown | — | — | | **HTML** | ✓ | ✓ web page | — | — | | **Books** EPUB, MOBI, AZW3 | ✓ without DRM | — | — | — | | **Recordings** WAV, MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis | ✓ transcribed on your machine | — | — | — | | **Podcast** (audio) | — | ✓ with a transcript, voiced on your machine by default | — | — | | **Mind maps, flashcards, quizzes** | — | ✓ in the app | — | — | ¹ With Office support (LibreOffice), turned on in Settings; it is never in the installer. ² Needs an image model, local or remote; none is chosen by default. ³ OCR reads Latin, Chinese and Japanese script. Edits, conversions and PDF tools always make a new file; your original is never changed. PDF, Word and Excel do the most today, and support for the other formats keeps improving. ## Plugins Connect them in **Settings › Plugins**. **By SurfSense.** They read public pages without your own accounts and need a SurfSense license: [download the app](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads) and enter your email there for a free 14-day one. | Plugin | What it does | |---|---| | **Google Search** | Search Google and read its results, ads and related questions | | **Web Crawl** | Read a web page, or crawl a whole site into clean text | | **YouTube** | Read YouTube videos, channels and their comments | | **TikTok** | Read TikTok videos and their comments, search users, and see what is trending | | **Reddit** | Read public Reddit posts with their comment threads, or a whole community | | **Instagram** | Read public Instagram profiles, posts and reels, and find profiles by search | | **Google Maps** | Find places on Google Maps and read their reviews | | **Amazon** | Read Amazon products and search results | | **Walmart** | Read Walmart products, search results and reviews | | **Indeed** | Read job listings on Indeed | **Third-party.** MCP servers from the [plugin registry](backend/plugins/registry), such as DeepWiki and Notion, or any you add by URL. No license needed; they stay off until you allow them. ## How it compares | | NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) | SurfSense | |---|---|---| | Runs offline / air-gapped | No | **Yes** | | Your documents leave your machine | Yes | **No**, unless you pick a remote model | | Can edit your files | No | **Yes** | | Open source | No | **Apache-2.0** | | Models | Gemini only | Any OpenAI-compatible API, or a local one | ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9) for help, [Issues](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/issues) for bugs, [Discussions](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/discussions) for ideas. - **Contributing:** PRs go against `dev`; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`surfsense_local/`](./surfsense_local) for the dev loop. How it works is in [`docs/`](docs/README.md). ## License Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
detail.readme_zh:
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/MODSetter/SurfSense?style=social)](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/stargazers) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/MODSetter/SurfSense?sort=semver)](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1359368468260192417?label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9)

SurfSense

可物理隔离运行的开源 NotebookLM 替代品。
在你自己的电脑上研究、转换和编辑文档的 AI 智能体。

下载 · 格式 · 快速开始 · 对比 · 插件 · 定价 · Discord

English | العربية | Deutsch | Español | Français | हिन्दी | 日本語 | 한국어 | Português | Русский | 简体中文

**用修订和批注批改合同** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88326b9d-e763-46db-9635-75f9df9e8682 **从网上添加来源，再把它们做成网页** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/073577b7-f055-4f59-8540-330bd764aeb0 SurfSense 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，专为那些不能上传的文档而做。它是一个注重隐私、类似 NotebookLM 的 AI 智能体，在你自己的电脑上研究、转换和编辑你的文档。索引留在你的硬盘里，模型由你来选，本地或远程都可以，而且不需要账号。 | 平台 | 下载 | |---|---| | **Windows** x64 | [SurfSense-Setup.exe](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/windows?src=readme) | | **macOS** Apple Silicon | [SurfSense-arm64.dmg](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/mac?src=readme) | | **Linux** x64 | [AppImage](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-appimage?src=readme) · [deb](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads/linux-deb?src=readme) | | **Docker** Linux, macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.sh \| bash` | | **Docker** Windows (Docker Desktop) | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/main/docker/scripts/install.ps1 \| iex` | > [!NOTE] > 用 Docker 在服务器上自托管，并在你网络中的任何设备上打开。再次运行同一条命令即可更新。 ## 快速开始 1. 安装 SurfSense，完成初始设置。 2. 把文件或文件夹拖放到来源中。 3. 让智能体搜索、提取或编辑你的文件。 ## 每种格式能做什么 | 格式 | 研究（带出处的回答） | 创建 | 编辑（以副本形式） | 转换 | |---|---|---|---|---| | **PDF** | ✓ 扫描页也可以³ | ✓ | 填写并拼合表单；添加水印、页码、页眉、页脚 | 合并、拆分、提取、旋转页面，调整页面顺序 | | **Word** `.docx` | ✓ | ✓ 也可以用你自己的 `.docx` 作模板 | ✓ 正文，以修订和批注的形式 | 转为 PDF¹ | | **Excel** `.xlsx` | ✓ 智能体还会读取公式 | ✓ 带公式和原生图表 | ✓ 单元格的值和公式 | 用 pandas 分析，并把结果做成图表 | | **PowerPoint** `.pptx` | ✓ | ✓ 也可以用你自己的 `.pptx` 作模板 | 替换幻灯片和备注中的文字；删除或复制幻灯片 | 转为 PDF¹ | | **CSV** | ✓ | — | — | 用 pandas 分析，并把结果做成图表 | | **图像** PNG、JPEG、TIFF、BMP、WebP | ✓ 通过 OCR 识别其中的文字³ | 图像和信息图，可按指令编辑² | — | 放入新文档 | | **Markdown**、纯文本 | ✓ | ✓ Markdown | — | — | | **HTML** | ✓ | ✓ 网页 | — | — | | **电子书** EPUB、MOBI、AZW3 | ✓ 无 DRM | — | — | — | | **录音** WAV、MP3、FLAC、Ogg Vorbis | ✓ 在你的电脑上转写 | — | — | — | | **播客**（音频） | — | ✓ 附文字稿，默认在你的电脑上配音 | — | — | | **思维导图、记忆卡片、测验** | — | ✓ 在应用内 | — | — | ¹ 需要在设置中开启 Office 支持（LibreOffice）；安装程序中从不包含它。² 需要一个图像模型，本地或远程均可；默认不选择任何模型。³ OCR 可识别拉丁字母、中文和日文。 编辑、转换和 PDF 工具总是生成一个新文件，你的原文件永远不会被改动。目前 PDF、Word 和 Excel 能做的事最多，对其他格式的支持也在不断改进。 ## 插件 在**设置 › 插件**中连接它们。 **SurfSense 提供：** 这些插件读取公开网页，不需要你自己的账号，但需要 SurfSense 许可证。[下载应用](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads)并在应用里填写你的邮箱，即可免费获得 14 天的许可证。 | 插件 | 功能 | |---|---| | **Google Search** | 在 Google 上搜索，并读取搜索结果、广告和相关问题 | | **Web Crawl** | 读取单个网页，或把整个网站抓取为干净的文本 | | **YouTube** | 读取 YouTube 视频、频道及其评论 | | **TikTok** | 读取 TikTok 视频及其评论，搜索用户，查看当前的热门内容 | | **Reddit** | 读取 Reddit 的公开帖子及其评论串，或整个社区 | | **Instagram** | 读取 Instagram 的公开主页、帖子和 Reels，并搜索主页 | | **Google Maps** | 在 Google Maps 上查找地点，并读取这些地点的评价 | | **Amazon** | 读取 Amazon 商品和搜索结果 | | **Walmart** | 读取 Walmart 商品、搜索结果和评价 | | **Indeed** | 读取 Indeed 上的职位信息 | **第三方：** 来自[插件注册表](backend/plugins/registry)的 MCP 服务器，例如 DeepWiki 和 Notion，或者你通过网址添加的任意服务器。不需要许可证；在你允许之前，它们一直保持关闭。 ## SurfSense 与同类工具对比 | | NotebookLM（现为 Gemini Notebook） | SurfSense | |---|---|---| | 可离线 / 物理隔离运行 | 否 | **是** | | 文档会离开你的电脑 | 会 | **不会**，除非你选择远程模型 | | 能编辑你的文件 | 否 | **是** | | 开源 | 否 | **Apache-2.0** | | 模型 | 只能用 Gemini | 任意兼容 OpenAI 的 API，或本地模型 | ## 社区 - [Discord](https://discord.gg/ejRNvftDp9) 用来求助，[Issues](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/issues) 用来报告缺陷，[Discussions](https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/discussions) 用来交流想法。 - **参与贡献：** PR 请提交到 `dev` 分支；开发流程见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和 [`surfsense_local/`](./surfsense_local)。工作原理见 [`docs/`](docs/README.md)。 ## 许可证 Apache-2.0。详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
